# Business Process Model

The Business Process Model says what is done and in which order. `next` arrows follow the flow; a process inside a larger process is `part-of` it. Stadium boxes are processes outside the project.

Method: 4EM (Sandkuhl, Stirna, Persson and Wißotzki, *Enterprise Modeling: Tackling Business Challenges with the 4EM Method*, Springer 2014). Every element cites its source; `decided` means a source shows that the operator decided it.

| <a id="process-flow-adopt-library"></a><code>process-flow-adopt-library</code><br/>Process | **A Foldkit app adopts the library.** A Foldkit developer adds a Flow to the application's Model, declares nodes, edges and handles, supplies the node views and a connection check, and applies the outcomes the Flow reports. The library reports outcomes, and the application applies the graph changes. Category: primary. | decided | serves: [A graph canvas for Foldkit applications](goals.md#goal-flow-vision); next: [A person works on the graph canvas](business-processes.md#process-flow-use-canvas); uses: [Flow](concepts.md#concept-flow-flow), [Node](concepts.md#concept-flow-node), [packages/flow (the library)](technical-components.md#comp-flow-library) | [log L109][93], [foldkit-flow:README.md:3][94], [foldkit-flow:README.md:24-64][95], [foldkit-flow:packages/flow/src/flow.ts:14-24][96] |
| <a id="process-flow-apply-outcome"></a><code>process-flow-apply-outcome</code><br/>Process | **The application applies an outcome.** The application receives an outcome message and applies the graph change itself: it adds an edge on Connected, moves one on Reconnected and records a Deleted set. The library reports the outcome, and the application may veto a change. Category: primary. | decided | serves: [A generic library with no product logic](goals.md#goal-flow-generic-library); uses: [Out-message (outcome)](concepts.md#concept-flow-out-message) | [log L109][93], [foldkit-flow:README.md:51-54][97], [foldkit-flow:packages/flow/src/update.ts:563-604][98] |

If Foldkit adopts the library, the project publishes `@foldkit/flow` and deprecates `@tsukuri/flow`. | <a id="process-flow-delete-selection"></a><code>process-flow-delete-selection</code><br/>Process | **Delete the selection.** A person presses Delete or Backspace. | <a id="process-flow-run-journey-gate"></a><code>process-flow-run-journey-gate</code><br/>Process | **Run the browser journey gate.** A contributor builds the example, then runs the journey in headless Chromium with real pointer and keyboard input. It runs locally only, not in `ready` or CI (see problem-flow-journey-not-in-ci). It exits 0 when the checks hold, 1 when a check fails and 75 when the performance check could not be timed on a busy host, which is not a pass.
